A good mind is not enough. How you use it is the practice.

Send this to someone who overthinks and wants to think better.

From "The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech." Link in bio.

#innerspeech #descartes #selftalk #thinking #mindset

text: “It is not enough to have a good mind; the main thing is to use it well.”
Being smart is not the same as thinking well.
Plenty of sharp minds spend years going in circles.
Often the circle runs through your inner voice.
*Why can’t I get this right? What if it goes wrong?*
That voice is a tool.
Used well, it plans, questions and encourages.
Used carelessly, it only repeats.
Using it well starts with listening.
What exactly are you saying to yourself, and in what tone?
Try this today:
When you catch a loop, say the next sentence out loud.
Hearing it often changes it.
Then answer it like a fair friend would.
Not with flattery, not with scorn.
With one honest, useful sentence.
What does your inner voice say most often when you are trying to think?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Learn to use the voice you think with, on purpose.
Hear the voice.
*Use it well.*
